title: ZuCo 2.0: A Dataset of Physiological Recordings During Natural Reading and Annotation
reasoning: The paper focuses on collecting and analyzing physiological data (EEG, eye-tracking) to understand cognitive processes during reading. It does not have any component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The mention of approval from an 'Ethics Commission' is a standard procedural note for research involving human participants and does not make ethics a subject of the study itself.
